card.name: Punctuation in carbonic anhydrase inhibitor lists
card.fires_on: The ".," after "e.g" in the carbonic anhydrase inhibitor interaction text (topiramate, zonisamide, acetazolamide). Also small linking words like "of" or "with" in nearby drug-interaction or dose-adjustment sentences.

modes.description: The punctuation after "e.g" that introduces zonisamide and acetazolamide as examples of carbonic anhydrase inhibitors.
